name: ai-slop
description: An Agent Skills bundle that catches AI slop in any prose, adding conventions for empirical software engineering papers and mechanics for LaTeX source (BibTeX, reference checks, citation macros, grounding comments), loaded automatically for .tex source, with --scientific opting a non-LaTeX manuscript into the paper conventions. Optional --ste and --economist layers add Simplified Technical English rules and core Economist style advice. Review modes fetch the live AI trope catalog from tropes.fyi. Glossary mode extracts definitions and checks terminology against a maintained GLOSSARY.md.

plugins.name: ai-slop
plugins.description: Catch AI slop and apply writing conventions to any prose, whether Markdown drafts, documentation, or a blog post. Reviewing .tex source adds the empirical software engineering paper rules plus LaTeX checks (BibTeX, reference verification) automatically. The --scientific flag applies the paper rules to a non-LaTeX manuscript, --ste adds Simplified Technical English rules, and --economist adds core Economist style advice. Combines these with the tropes.fyi catalog of general AI writing patterns by Ossama Chaib. Glossary mode extracts definitions and checks terminology against a maintained GLOSSARY.md.
